accuracy_confidence_intervals.nature: Binomial proportion (k=1496 successes out of n=1500 trials)
accuracy_confidence_intervals.wilson_methodology: Wilson score interval with parameter z=1.95996
accuracy_confidence_intervals.bootstrap_methodology: Non-parametric empirical percentile bootstrap (B=10000 resamples, seed=42)

f1_confidence_intervals.nature: Nonlinear composite metric (harmonic mean of precision and recall)
f1_confidence_intervals.wilson_inapplicability_justification: The Wilson score interval is strictly formulated for independent Bernoulli trials with a binomial distribution k ~ Bin(n, p). F1-score is a ratio of random variables (2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN)) and cannot be represented as a binomial success proportion k/n. Direct application of the Wilson score formula to F1 is statistically invalid.
f1_confidence_intervals.bootstrap_methodology: Non-parametric empirical percentile bootstrap (B=10000 resamples, seed=42)
